page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Above the text: an ornamental woodcut headpiece. Then title headings centred, a sub-heading, and the body text with a large woodcut initial. A signature mark "A.j." at the foot right. Page number "I" at top right. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: AD LIBELLVM AB ANONYMO QVODAM RECENS AEDITUM, hoc titulo.
DE EXTERNA SEU visibili Dei Ecclesia, ubi illa reperiri possit, & quaenam vera sit, &c. seu potius, aduersus Externam & visibilem Ecclesiam.
LAMB. DANÆI PRO EXTERNA SEV VISIBILI ECCLESIA, necessaria Responsio.
main_text.p: ANTEQVAM, viri fratres mihi in Christo charissimi, ad illum librum respondeam, quem ad me misistis (Dominū Deum precatus vt ipsius gloriæ, atque Ecclesiæ Dei sit magna ipsius misericordia, vtilis hic labor meus) de re ipsa, de qua futura est disputatio, paucis dicam; vt responsiones nostræ ad proposita argumenta facilius intelligi, & veritas ipsa (quam ipsius libri scriptor, quantum potuit, ipsissimis tenebris inuoluere

page.notes: The large initial A is a woodcut letter; read as "ANTEQVAM" with the initial A joined. Page-top has faint show-through, not transcribed. The word "proposita" contains a Cyrillic-like look-alike risk; written as Latin "proposita" intended. "ipsissimis" is as printed.
